title: Mixing: Junk, Teddy Boy, Kreen-Akrore by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio One, Morgan Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Robin Black

Paul McCartney mixed three songs for the McCartney album on 26 February 1970.

McCartney and engineer Robin Black made final mixes of ‘Junk’, ‘Teddy Boy’, and ‘Kreen-Akrore’.

Page last updated: 10 November 2025

  • 1975: Recording: Venus And Mars, Rock Show by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Ram by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1971: Paul McCartney’s court hearing to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership – day six
  • 1970: US album release: Hey Jude
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas

  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont Cinema, Taunton
